title: Check-in devices
description: Pair Android scanners, manage their events and get the app.

serverWarning.title: Phones cannot reach this server address
serverWarning.text: The scanner address is {url}, which only works on this computer. Set the address of this server on your network (for example http://192.168.1.20:8080) so the pairing QR code and download links work on phones.
serverWarning.textMissing: No server address is configured. Set it so the pairing QR code and download links work on phones.

insecureWarning.title: The scanner address is not encrypted
insecureWarning.text: {url} uses plain http:// on a public address. Device tokens and ticket data would travel unencrypted. Use https:// or an address inside your private network.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.empty: No device has been paired yet.
devices.name: Device

edit.title: Edit device
edit.name: Device name
edit.eventsHint: The device can scan the selected events. Choose the entrance it is stationed at to get a warning for guests at the wrong entrance.

revoke.title: Revoke device?
revoke.text: {name} can no longer sync or scan. The app is told to unpair itself. This cannot be undone; pair the device again to use it.

delete.title: Delete device?
delete.text: {name} disappears from this list. Its scan history stays and still shows the device name.

pair.title: Pair a device
pair.description: Open the scanner app on the phone and scan the QR code that appears here.
pair.label: Device name (optional)
pair.labelHint: Shown in the scan log, e.g. “Door A”. Empty = the name the phone reports.
pair.scanHint: Scan this code with the scanner app, or enter the code by hand.

apk.title: Scanner app
apk.description: Signed Android app (Android 8 or newer). Staff install it once; paired devices are told when a newer version is available.
apk.none: No app version has been published yet.
apk.linkText: Open this link on the phone (or scan the QR code) and install the app. The link is valid until {time}.
apk.deleteText: Version {name} is removed from the server.

upload.title: Upload a new version
upload.versionNameHint: As shown in the app, e.g. 1.2.0
upload.versionCodeHint: The integer versionCode of the build; must be higher than the previous one.

apk.linkTextGithub: Open this link on the phone (or scan the QR code) and download the app from the GitHub release page.

github.title: Updates come from GitHub releases ({repository})
github.text: Default channel: {channel}. Uploads below are only used in “own server” mode, and once for older apps that cannot use GitHub yet.
github.uploadsHint: Uploaded versions are only offered to older app versions that cannot use GitHub yet (so they can step up once).
github.noRepository: Updates are set to GitHub, but no repository is configured here. Apps use the repository built into their release build, if any. Set a repository in the scanner settings, or switch to “own server”.

checkIn.title: Check-in
checkIn.description: Live progress and the scan journal of this event.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.SERVER_URL_MISSING: Set the scanner server address in the scanner settings first.
errors.NOT_AN_APK: The file is not an APK.
errors.INVALID_VERSION_CODE: The version code must be a positive whole number.
errors.VERSION_CODE_EXISTS: A release with this version code already exists.
errors.RELEASE_IS_CURRENT: The current release cannot be deleted. Publish another one first.
errors.DEVICE_NOT_REVOKED: Only revoked devices can be deleted. Revoke the device first.
errors.NO_RELEASE: No app version has been published yet. Upload an APK and publish it first.
errors.NO_REPOSITORY: No GitHub repository is configured. Set it in the scanner settings first.
